title: Catching Feebas in Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl
excerpt: Catch Feebas incredibly fast in BDSP with our guide
author: PokeLore.net

sections.text: Tragically, the overworld effect which increases fishing odds of [Sticky Hold](/move/sticky-hold) and [Suction Cups](/move/suction-cups) has no effect in BDSP because of a bug that existed in Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum. Gamefreak decided to carry this forward.
All is not lost however, We have a few tricks to guarentee you can catch the shabby and elusive [Feebas](/pokemon/feebas).

sections.caption: They're down there, taunting you.

sections.text: Feebas Tile Calculator: The Absurdly Fast Method
If you have no qualms about using an external tool to calculate the exact tile Feebas will spawn on, this is the absurdly easy method for you.

items: Jubilife City Lotto Number (If your game has been updated past 1.1.3, you will need 2 days in a row)

sections.text: Head to [https://lincoln-lm.github.io/JS-Finder/Tools/BDSPFeebas.html](https://lincoln-lm.github.io/JS-Finder/Tools/BDSPFeebas.html) and utilize his incredibly useful calculator to find out which tiles in Mt. Coronet have a 50% chance of fishing up a Feebas. Simply head to those tiles and fish away!
Maybe you like the nostaliga of the hunt, or maybe you enjoy pain.

items: 10-15 Poké Balls (Feebas is an easy catch once hooked)

sections.text: Head to the bottom of Mt. Coronet to the lake on BF1. You will need Strength to get there. Begin Surfing, use your Repels. FISH ONE ENCOUNTER PER TILE. Do not fish 2-3 as most guides recommend. This wastes time. The next fresh tile will always have a higher chance of holding a Feebas than the tile you have fished.

Keep fishing one encounter tile by tile until you have either found a Feebas, or fished through the entire lake. It is unlikely, but If you reach the end of the lake without finding Feebas, simply make your way back through the lake again.

sections.title: Yes really, once per tile.
sections.text: The next unfished (or fished less) tile, will always have a higher chance of holding Feebas than one you just fished.

NOTE: This applies to Route 119 in Hoenn, but the same logic applies here. flipflipshift on reddit has done math explaining why fishing each tile once as you go through the river is fastest. These numbers are taken directly from his post. (link below) These number show the average number of encounters that can be expected from each method before Feebas is encountered. Please see his original post (link at the bottom of this guide)
Once you catch [Feebas](/pokemon/feebas) (and you will!) Take a look at our guide. [Evolving Feebas into Milotic Via Beauty](/topic/evolving-feebas-into-milotic-via-beauty)
